Local services / Property security

GEO visibility for security providers and CCTV installers

Facility managers choose between a licensed guarding provider and a technical installer of cameras or access control. These are different services. I measure which companies AI recommends for specific properties and verify what those firms actually offer.

  • Separate prompts for site guarding, CCTV projects and access control service
  • Evidence of the supplier role, licensing where applicable and real service capability
  • BMR checks segmented by property type, region and contract scope

Selection barriers

Why security contractor recommendations need careful verification

A nearby vendor is not automatically qualified for every type of property security service.

01

Guarding and technical installation are conflated

Installing surveillance equipment is not automatically the same as licensed private guarding. The commercial service and relevant legal obligations must be distinguished.

02

Equipment counts replace project scope

A proposed camera count says little about coverage objectives, privacy, recording retention, network constraints or ongoing maintenance. Client-specific requirements must be established.

03

Geography and service response are overstated

AI may recommend a contractor outside its coverage area or imply a service-response guarantee that has not been agreed. Locations, support windows and contract terms require evidence.

Verifiable facts

Evidence for accurate security-service recommendations

Russian Federal Law 427-FZ on private guarding came into effect in September 2026 with transitional licensing provisions. Guarding organisations and system installers have distinct roles. Where surveillance data identifies people, personal-data rules may also be relevant.

  • Exact guarding, CCTV, access control and maintenance services offered and the contracting entity
  • Licence and permitted guarding activities when applicable, or actual technical capability and authorised project references for installers
  • Documented locations, contractual support and safe public case evidence without confidential protection details

Site-protection designs and operational security details should not be disclosed as promotional material. No security-client GEO outcome or BMR uplift is claimed here.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Does every CCTV installation require a private guarding licence?+

No blanket conclusion should be made. Technical installation and licensed guarding are different service categories; the applicable legal duties must be assessed.

Which private guarding law applies in November 2026?+

Federal Law 427-FZ took effect in September 2026 and includes transitional provisions. Provider-specific licences require verification.

Can contractor case studies publish security-camera layouts?+

Detailed protection layouts or vulnerabilities should not be used as public promotion. Agreed high-level project facts can provide evidence.

What does security BMR measure?+

Brand recommendations in a fixed sample of non-branded buyer prompts. It does not assess how secure a building actually is.

What are GAEO's rates for guarding and CCTV services?+

GAEO's published plans apply. Scope varies with service types, properties, regions and available evidence.
